alex.k: Quick follow-up on the MHA layout RFC — I prototyped NHWC vs NCHW on Ampere and saw odd prefetch head-of-line stalls when QKV are interleaved. Notes below.

maria.t: Can you paste the microbench numbers?

alex.k: yes — short:
- NHWC contiguous QKV (interleaved per-token): 1.0x baseline latency, higher L2 miss rate
- NCHW separate Q,K,V planes: 0.92x latency, better prefetch
- Fused QKV kernel (pack into shared mem): 0.85x but higher compile complexity

sophie: Interesting. Did you try increasing stride to align to 128B? That matters for coalescing.

tim.b: FWIW on GPU warps we want contiguous 32B per thread lane; padding to 64/128B can harm bank conflicts tho.

alex.k: Exactly — I suspect CPU prefetcher treats interleaved QKV as non-unit stride. On GPU, interleaving helps coalescing for sequence-major layouts but hurts when head_dim small.

benchbot: microbench run 1923456799: attached summary, 10 runs each. See snippet:
```
layout,lat_ms,l2_miss
NHWC-interleaved,12.4,0.18
NCHW-split,11.4,0.12
Fused-packed,9.7,0.08
```

maria.t: So what's the recommended canonical in runtime? Keep one layout or expose both?

sophie: Propose runtime default = NCHW with split Q/K/V for our small-head configs, with a kernel selector that can pick fused-packed for large-head/high-throughput cases.

tim.b: We need API surface: either model metadata flags (preferred) or runtime autodetect with a heuristic. I vote for explicit flag in model config + fallback.

alex.k: Implementation notes:
- Add flag `attention_layout: [nhwc_interleaved, nchw_split, fused_packed]` in model manifest
- Kernel selector priority table (prefers fused where supported and batch > X)

alex.k: example table:
```
if gpu && batch_size>=16 && head_dim>=64 -> fused_packed
elif gpu && head_dim<64 -> nchw_split
else -> nhwc_interleaved
```

maria.t: Yeah, need perf tests in the CI and a gating perf-suite. Also add evictions for KV cache when switching layouts.

sophie: KV cache implications: switching between layouts requires transpose cost on the fly. Option: maintain dual buffers during rollout but that doubles memory.

tim.b: memory budget should be in selector too. If memory pressure high -> prefer split (lower peak).

infra-bot: Note: created perf job `mha-layout/compare-1923456802` (queued)

alex.k: Action items:
- alex.k: add model manifest flag RFC draft
- sophie: prototype selector and mem heuristics
- tim.b: add CI perf job and gating
- maria.t: update docs + rollout plan

maria.t: +1, please keep the prototype in eng-runtime branch `mha-layout-prefetch` and tag me.
